query: SELECT count(*) AS "count!" FROM (SELECT COALESCE(w.balance,0) AS actual,COALESCE(l.recorded,0) AS recorded FROM wallets w FULL JOIN (SELECT account,sum(delta) AS recorded FROM ledger_entries WHERE account LIKE 'user:%' GROUP BY account) l ON l.account='user:'||w.user_id::text) balances WHERE actual<>recorded
